# Justusability research SDK

Local 0.1.0 candidate. Publication and hosted service cutover are pending.

- [Guide](https://research.justusability.com/sdk)
- [Data and security](https://research.justusability.com/sdk/data-security)
- [Source snapshots and releases](https://research.justusability.com/sdk/releases)
- [Participant privacy](https://research.justusability.com/i/privacy)

Public API: init, identify, pause, resume, destroy, getStatus. Browser global: Justusability. Package: @justusability/sdk. Human-led research only; participant consent is separate from installation. No passive host-page capture.
